name: Last Stop
tagline: Keeps a public atlas of Grok bots and files each new find as a skill
description: Looks after a published map of Grok bots. Ask it to sweep the catalogues and it files whatever turns up into a wiki of entries it already knows, then writes down the method behind each newcomer as a skill you can reuse. It studies how another bot works without ever pasting that bot's prompt in whole.
author: FantomBuildz
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
